standard.name: agentskills
standard.note: The rules in bin/lib/rules.mjs mirror the spec at this hash. Re-pinning is a deliberate act after reconciling the mirror rule by rule.

gates.name: acceptance
gates.fix: make the criterion true or hand it back; close a green requirement; give every requirement a status

gates.name: contracts
gates.fix: keep the seam's promise, or hand it back to the architect

gates.name: units
gates.fix: fix the unit; never edit the test to pass

gates.name: rules
gates.fix: obey the skill rules (name, description, MIT, budget, depth, no vendor, no dash)

gates.name: ledger
gates.fix: evidence the rung or lower it

gates.name: format
gates.fix: npx prettier --write . (npm install first if the formatter is missing)
